title: On a slow connection the leaderboard shows only a spinner for over 30 seconds
what_happened: On a weak signal I opened the leaderboard. For more than 30 seconds the page was an empty header, a spinner and the footer. When it finally filled in, it said 0 Total Participants.
expected: The board, or at least its heading and a message, in a few seconds even on a slow connection

title: Cookie box covers the footer, which holds the only leaderboard link
what_happened: On the phone the cookie box sits over the bottom of the page. The leaderboard link lives only in the footer, so my first tap on it did nothing until I dismissed the box.
expected: The leaderboard reachable from the top menu, or a cookie box that does not cover the links under it
